name: Red Harvest
body:
School necromancy; Level antipaladin 3, arcanist 3, bloodrager 3, cleric 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, medium 3, oracle 3, sorcerer 3, spiritualist 3, witch 3, wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Area 20-ft.-radius emanation centered on you
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You siphon the blood of nearby creatures, drinking in its power to bolster your own strength. When an opponent within the spell’s area takes bleed damage, you gain temporary hit points equal to the bleed damage taken by that opponent. These temporary hit points stack with themselves and last for the spell’s duration.

Mythic Whenever you gain temporary hit points as a result of this spell, you also heal a number of hit points equal to half the number of temporary hit points gained by that instance of bleed damage.

Augmented (4th): If you expend two uses of mythic power, the siphoned blood heals you continuously. When an opponent within the spell’s area takes bleed damage, you gain fast healing equal to the amount of bleed damage in addition to the temporary hit points. Unlike temporary hit points, this fast healing does not stack, and lasts as long as any single creature within the spell’s area takes at least 1 bleed damage every round.
